reason: We have decided on the new market and I have no pipeline there, so a free list of 15 targets and a pilot where the first 3 meetings are free and the total is capped below what I paid for one trade fair stand is easy to justify. I would pick relationship mode and approve every message myself, so I control what goes out under our name.
objection: If someone sends a clumsy or pushy message in our name in a market where we are new, we are burned with those buyers before we start, and if there is a GDPR complaint it is my problem. One logistics client with 45 meetings is not enough proof that they understand buyers in manufacturing.
would_change_my_mind: If the 15 free target companies are generic or wrong for our niche, or the first message reads like spam, I stop there. A reference I can call from a manufacturer or exporter like us would make me commit faster.
